strategies.name: S1 — v1 best (log-price, engineered feats)
strategies.description: Previous best: log(price) target, 100 trees, depth=26, engineered features

strategies.name: S2 — Rate-per-carat target (log(price/carat))
strategies.description: log(price/carat) target → removes multiplicative carat effect from prediction error

strategies.name: S4 — Rate + MAE + engineered features
strategies.description: log(price/carat) + MAE splits + bucket-position + dimension features, 150 trees

strategies.name: S5 — Rate + lookup as feature + category prior
strategies.description: log(price/carat) + lookup rate/category prior as features + MAE criterion

strategies.name: S6 — Rate + category prior feature
strategies.description: log(price/carat) + per-category median rate as feature + MAE criterion

strategies.name: S7 — Full combo (rate + MAE + all features + 200 trees)
strategies.description: All innovations: rate target, MAE splits, lookup+category priors, depth=None, 200 trees

strategies.name: S8 — LightGBM quantile(0.5) rate target
strategies.description: LightGBM quantile=0.5 on log(price/carat) → median regression, MAPE-optimal

strategies.name: S9 — Rate + MSE + all features (ablation of MAE vs MSE)
strategies.description: Same as S7 but MSE criterion instead of MAE — ablation study

strategies.name: S11 — Temporal cutoff (S3 on recent 70% data)
strategies.description: Same as S3 but trained only on most recent 70% of data — isolates temporal rate-card mixing

strategies.name: S12 — Fine lookup (0.01ct + Cut, no ML)
strategies.description: Direct lookup at 0.01ct×Cut resolution. Fallback distribution: {'A': 4801, 'G': 252, 'F': 422, 'C': 82, 'E': 97, 'H': 13, 'B': 7, 'I': 5}

strategies.name: S13 — Two-stage (lookup + ML residual)
strategies.description: Stage1: fine lookup consensus. Stage2: ExtraTrees on residual using Polish/Sym/measurements/magic features

strategies.name: S14 — Cut-specific models + magic features
strategies.description: Separate ExtraTrees per Cut grade (EX, ID, VG, 传统切, 冰花切, 老欧切, 老矿切, 长垫形) with magic threshold features

strategies.name: S15 — S3 + magic threshold features
strategies.description: S3 base + 1/(carat-magic+eps), log(1+dist), magic_number features to capture premium decay

strategies.name: S16 — S3 + Cut×Carat + Cut×Color×Clarity interactions
strategies.description: Explicit Cut×carat_bucket and Cut×Color×Clarity interaction features on top of S3

strategies.name: S17 — Full combo v2 (temporal + lookup + magic + Cut interactions)
strategies.description: All structural fixes: temporal cutoff, fine lookup, magic thresholds, Cut interactions, 200 trees

strategies.name: S18 — Temporal cutoff, shallower trees
strategies.description: S11 recent 70% window with base features, 200 trees, max_depth=24 to reduce within-window overfit

bestStrategy.name: S18 — Temporal cutoff, shallower trees
bestStrategy.description: S11 recent 70% window with base features, 200 trees, max_depth=24 to reduce within-window overfit

bestModel.description: S11 recent 70% window with base features, 200 trees, max_depth=24 to reduce within-window overfit
